kind: assumed inputs; nothing in this file is measured in the Demerzel repository
event: The effectiveness label of an artifact differs between two consecutive rows of its history (outcome 1 = changed, 0 = unchanged).

forecasters.note: Imaginary forecasters scored on the observed pairs. Each states a probability that the label changes at the artifact's next row. None of them exists or was issued before the outcomes; every probability below is an assumption, read as the exact decimal it is written as.

never.description: States probability 0 of a change on every pair: PSY-005's persistence forecast, stated with certainty.

base_rate.description: States on every pair the share of all usable pairs that changed. That share is known only after every outcome has been seen: a hindsight forecast, used as the reference for skill.

one_percent.description: States probability 0.01 of a change on every pair.

five_percent.description: States probability 0.05 of a change on every pair.

coin.description: States probability 0.5 of a change on every pair.

long_step_hedge.description: Looks only at the earlier row of the pair: 0.1 when it is a seed row (the long step to the first feeder run), 0.001 otherwise. Both values were chosen by the author after seeing the data.

hypothesis_check.note: Thresholds of the hypothesis in the research-cycle record, which was written before the analysis was first run: constant forecasts between 0 and 0.01 score within 0.0001 of one another, and the changed pair supplies most (more than half) of each of those scores.

worked_examples.note: Inputs of the lesson's exercises that are not in its tables.

proper_scoring.note: Synthetic. An event is assumed to occur with a known true probability; a forecaster states one of the probabilities of the grid on every case. Expected scores are closed forms; the simulation draws the stated number of cases with random.Random(seed).random() < true probability.

transfer_task.note: Hypothetical release log for the learner task. Not Streeling data and not a forecast.
transfer_task.event: the release is rolled back within a day
